checks.name: no fee rule exists before authoring
the maker is not offered the checker workspace
the independent checker approved the fee proposal
the inbox applied the VAT + min/max fee and consumed the approval
the preview panel names the applied rule id
the preview panel renders a non-zero VAT and the authored flat fee
preview and runtime agree on the rule, the fee, the VAT and the total
no journal was posted by preview or quote
the profile created from the Studio exists and is enabled
the limit proposal writes no rule
the checker approved the limit proposal
the limit execution applied exactly one DAILY_AMOUNT rule
the preview panel shows the authored DAILY_AMOUNT threshold
runtime admits an amount inside the authored threshold
runtime refuses an amount above the authored threshold
runtime evaluated the rule the browser applied

regressionGuards: PR27-BROWSER-01 (fixed in this revision): the authored fee carries vatBps 750 and a 50/500 minimum/maximum collar, and is applied by the inbox Execute button, not by an API replay.
